dataset.source: deterministic generated telemetry plus a scripted validation-only inventory degradation

limitations: This is deterministic synthetic telemetry, not a held-out production or incident dataset.
The test period contains few controlled degradation episodes; event-warning estimates are correspondingly unstable.
No probability calibration or prediction interval is evaluated.
If the Random Forest does not outperform the simpler baseline, the simpler method is preferable unless another operational criterion justifies the model.

event_warning.definition: Ground truth comes from synthetic anomaly labels; first positive prediction in the five-minute pre-onset window, with alerts at/after onset excluded.

persistence_threshold_baseline.method: Alert when current observed p95 latency >= 1.0 seconds.

leakage_controls: Only current/past features are used by feature_dataset.
Future five-minute labels are excluded from the preceding split at both boundaries.
Imputation/scaling/model fit occur on train only.
Classification threshold is selected on validation only; test is evaluated once.
splits.ordering: global chronological; train 60%, validation 20%, test 20% by unique timestamp

target: any p95 latency >= 1.0 seconds in the next 5 one-minute samples
